rules.build: latest build command authoritative exit_code and timed_out
rules.fixed_task_oracle: latest exact fixed smoke command; absence is not_observed
rules.author_tests: original CTest XML must contain full fixed count and actual Passed statuses; no XML is not_observed unless log establishes execution began
rules.stage: latest artifact_stage command, exact delivery set and bytes against replay separately
rules.replay: latest actual attempt status/checks; absent is not_observed
rules.source: all frozen original regular files SHA-256; original and replay independently
rules.cleanup: actual named original/replay containers must be absent
rules.interpretation: build_pass_without_strict is an endpoint discrepancy, not an estimated natural false_acceptance rate
